data_testid_convention.rules: All interactive buttons, links, search inputs, quantity toggles, cart triggers, and CRUD actions must specify kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖, 🧠, 💭, 💡) for icons. Use Lucide or Heroicons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Since .js files are used (not .tsx), ensure all components use proper React JSX syntax.
